data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Kakao APIs: login, talk sharing, user and navigation features.
data.what_it_does: Provides wrappers around Kakao's REST APIs for authentication, KakaoTalk sharing, user profile, and navigation services. Handles platform-specific integration for Android and iOS.
use_when: You need Kakao social login in a Flutter app
You want to share content via KakaoTalk or use Kakao Navi
avoid_when: You target platforms other than Android/iOS (web support is pending)
You need a lightweight solution without native SDK dependencies
strengths: Supports both login and sharing flows
weaknesses: Requires native setup on both Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Add native Kakao SDK keys, configure Android manifest and iOS Info.plist, and run flutter pub get; no build_runner needed unless customizing JSON models.

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need generic sharing without Kakao‑specific features
